prep.summary: You initiated the unified telematics platform vision—driven by a direct request from Aaron Bend—to construct a high-level architecture and standard design pattern. This foundational design—tracked during your mid-May alignment with Steve—aims to synthesize disparate telemetry feeds into a single enterprise framework. You must now evaluate this architectural pattern against the company's stricter automated deployment gates—ensuring the design bypasses the governance bottlenecks currently stalling other horizontal capabilities.
tasks: Retrieve the high-level telematics architecture—originally drafted in mid-May for Aaron Bend—to verify compatibility with the unified platform vision.
Resolve the outstanding governance blockages—specifically the Model Risk Management and Gen AI Council chokeholds—that threaten to delay telemetry data ingestion.
Map the telematics data stream requirements to the three-tier Snowflake architecture—Base, Aggregate, and Memory—to ensure compliance with the enterprise data product strategy.
Enforce strict alignment with the new automated deployment gates to prevent downstream pipeline blocks during the platform rollout.
prep.title: Risk Lens - Unified Telematics Read-out

prep.summary: You must brief Hima on the upcoming P&C Billing Bot employee pilot—targeting 20 to 50 internal users—and the scheduled late-May Two-Way Texting Rec sessions. Finalizing the security boundaries remains a critical precursor to these sessions—requiring urgent alignment with Corey Newsome on governance roles. You also need to address the AWS POC for Agent Assist—now delayed to June 11th—and settle the outstanding funding disputes for AWS Professional Services.
tasks: Confirm the final launch parameters and target audience for the P&C Billing Bot MVP.
Coordinate with Corey Newsome to lock down governance and control frameworks before the late-May texting sessions.
Resolve the internal funding deadlock regarding AWS Professional Services and environment rentals for the June 11th proof-of-concept.
Extract security precedents from the Claims team to accelerate the Digital Network Services framework.
